title: ferula licentiana var. tunshanica
intro: Ferula licentiana var. tunshanica, commonly known as Tunshan ferula, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae) native to China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antibacterial effects, providing relief from pain, swelling, and infections. The health benefits of Ferula licentiana var. tunshanica include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and treating digestive issues, thanks to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ferulic acid, which is responsible for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
